summary: BNB Plus Corp. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to a Registration Rights Agreement dated May 26, 2026, with purchasers holding 50.1% or more of registrable securities. The amendment extends the filing date for a registration statement to 30 calendar days after the final closing of all purchasers, which must occur by July 17, 2026. The filing involves only a contractual modification, not a merger, tender, or restructuring. No deal terms, premiums, or advisors are mentioned. This is a routine administrative current report and does not constitute a special situation.
